name: Veto Check and Priority Improvements for a Product Review
prompt:
Audit the following product review content against CORE-EEAT standards. Treat it as a "Product Review" content type.

---
Title: XPhone Pro 15 Review

The XPhone Pro 15 is the best phone ever made. Buy it now. It has a great camera and amazing battery life. Everyone loves this phone. Get 20% off with code SAVE20. This phone will change your life. I tested hundreds of phones and this is number one. Trust me.
---

Produce a file called product_review_audit.json with exactly this structure:
- "content_title": string
- "content_type": string (must be "Product Review")
- "veto_check": object with keys "T04_disclosure" (string: "Pass", "Partial", or "Fail"), "C01_intent_alignment" (string: "Pass", "Partial", or "Fail"), "R10_content_consistency" (string: "Pass", "Partial", or "Fail"), "any_veto_triggered" (boolean)
- "dimension_scores": object with keys "C", "O", "R", "E", "Exp", "Ept", "A", "T" — each a number 0-100
- "geo_score": number (average of C, O, R, E, rounded to 1 decimal)
- "seo_score": number (average of Exp, Ept, A, T, rounded to 1 decimal)
- "total_score": number between 0 and 100
- "rating": string — one of "Excellent", "Good", "Medium", "Low", "Poor"
- "critical_issues": array of strings listing the specific veto items that triggered (empty array if none triggered)
- "top_improvements": array of exactly 5 objects, each with keys "id" (string), "name" (string), "current_status" (string: "Fail" or "Partial"), "action" (string)

Note: The content contains a promotional discount code and unsubstantiated superlative claims — these should be reflected in veto item evaluations where applicable.

criteria.description: product_review_audit.json file is present in the working directory.

product_review_audit.json is valid JSON with all required top-level keys: content_title, content_type, veto_check, dimension_scores, geo_score, seo_score, total_score, rating, critical_issues, and top_improvements.
The content_type field equals exactly the string "Product Review".
veto_check.any_veto_triggered is true, reflecting that the promotional discount code or unsubstantiated claims triggered at least one veto item.
dimension_scores contains all 8 keys (C, O, R, E, Exp, Ept, A, T), each a number between 0 and 100.
geo_score equals the arithmetic mean of C, O, R, E within a tolerance of 1 point.
seo_score equals the arithmetic mean of Exp, Ept, A, T within a tolerance of 1 point.
total_score is a number strictly below 60, reflecting the low-quality promotional content.
critical_issues is a non-empty array listing the specific veto items that were triggered.
top_improvements is an array of exactly 5 objects, each with id, name, current_status (Fail/Partial), and a non-empty action string.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent audited a low-quality product review containing promotional language, unsubstantiated claims, and a discount code — all quality red flags.

Criterion 1: Appropriate Score Calibration (Weight: 60%)
1.0: Total score is in the Low or Poor range (below 60) reflecting the content's obvious quality problems. Veto items T04 and/or C01 are triggered given the promotional/disclosure issues. The agent correctly identified the discount code and superlatives as problems.
0.5: Score exists and is below 75 but veto logic is inconsistent or missed obvious issues.
0: Score is unreasonably high (above 75) for this low-quality content, or veto items are all Pass despite obvious issues.

Criterion 2: Specificity of Improvements (Weight: 40%)
1.0: Top 5 improvements directly call out specific problems in this content — the discount code, missing test methodology, unsubstantiated claims, lack of disclosure. Actions are concrete.
0.5: Improvements are partially relevant but miss the most obvious issues.
0: Improvements are generic or irrelevant to this specific content.
eval.name: Quality Judge
